title: Speed: mixed + evaluation order
prompt:
SPEED DRILL — target under 90 seconds.

What is printed?

```java
System.out.println(1 + 2 + "3" + 4 + 5);
```

A. `12345`
B. `3345`
C. `15`
D. `339`

Call `answer(...)` exactly once with your option letter and a one-sentence reason.

tests.name: B speed
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.answer("B. check"));
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("B"), "answer must start with the correct option letter");
tests.hint: B. Left-to-right: 1+2 is int 3, then 3+"3" is "33", then string-append 4 and 5 → 3345. A ignores the int start; C evaluates everything numerically; D adds the tail numerically.
